purpose: Curated registry of extended blog articles derived from teaching themes. The audience pathway is social media to blog to class; the editorial workflow is class to blog to social media.

policy.publication_boundary: Formal scholarly outputs and citable scientific notes belong in Publications, not in the Blog.

posts.title: Statistical distributions for fisheries and marine ecology
posts.excerpt: A practical guide to choosing probability distributions for presence-absence, counts, CPUE, biomass, proportions, compositional data, and extreme events in fisheries and marine ecology.
